summary: Verified MapView.jsx SyntaxError fix at runtime. The required structure (`const initMapLayers = () => { ... }` at ~L195 followed by `if (map.isStyleLoaded()) initMapLayers(); else map.on('load', initMapLayers);` at L237-238) is present in the codebase and there is NO stray `map.on('load', () => {` block. Production build compiles cleanly (per review note). Runtime: bundle loads with zero SyntaxError, Owner login works, /map SPA route renders the shell (sidebar, 'Property Acquisition', 'Draw new territory' button, and `[data-testid=map-container]`) with NO '[MapLibre error]' console messages and NO uncaught JS from MapView. Full map+clustering+drawing behavior could not be exercised because the seeded org is in SUSPENDED subscription state (as flagged in the review request): `/api/map-config` and `/api/territories` return HTTP 403 with `code=subscription_inactive`. Because MapView instantiates `new maplibregl.Map(...)` inside the `api.get('/map-config').then(...)` callback, the 403 short-circuits map instantiation entirely (map-container is present but empty; canvas count 0; No territories in list). This is a paywall-gating behavior of the current backend state, NOT a regression from the initMapLayers structural fix — the fix under test is compile-time and its runtime code path is only reachable when /map-config resolves 200.

minor.issue: Returns 403 under SUSPENDED subscription; frontend MapView cannot init map at all (no fallback default center/zoom). Consider allowing /map-config as a read-only/public gate so the shell can still show a base OSM map even when suspended (aligns with the review note claim that 'shell + Map still render').

integration_issues.issue: MapView's `new maplibregl.Map(...)` is inside `api.get('/map-config').then(...)`. When /map-config 403s (suspended sub), the map is never created, so map-container is empty and clustering/drawing cannot be tested. Also produces an uncaught AxiosError 403 shown in the webpack-dev-server error overlay.

action_items: No action required for the reported SyntaxError bug — the fix is already in place and the production build + runtime bundle load are clean.

Optional (out of scope for this ticket): to make the review-note claim ('shell + Map still render under suspended subscription') true, either (a) exempt GET /api/map-config from the subscription gate so a base map can render, or (b) fall back to a default map-config on the frontend when /map-config 403s, and add `.catch` to swallow the axios error so it doesn't hit the webpack overlay.
To fully re-verify the runtime clustering/pin/drawing behaviors, reactivate the seeded org's subscription (or point the environment at an ACTIVE control-plane entitlement) and re-run this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: MapView.jsx L177-239: map instantiation is gated behind /map-config; there is no .catch on the axios promise, so any non-200 leaks as an uncaught rejection. Recommend `.catch((e) => console.warn('[MapView] map-config failed, using defaults', e))` plus default center/zoom fallback.
MapView.jsx is 441 lines — still under the 700-line threshold but approaching it; clustering/drawing helpers could be extracted for maintainability.
